facts.label: Agora e planos
facts.sub: Use am/is/are + -ing para agora e am/is/are going to + verbo para planos: I’m looking at the menu. I’m going to order salmon.

facts.label: Agora
facts.sub: Para o que acontece agora, use am/is/are + -ing: I’m looking at the menu. The chef is making rice. Use am com I, is com he, she e it, e are com you, we e they.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para planos, use am/is/are going to + verbo: I’m going to order salmon. Os dois tempos podem aparecer juntos: I’m looking at the menu, and I’m going to try sushi.

paragraphs: It is Saturday night in a small sushi bar in Portland. Soft music plays near the kitchen. Rui sits at the counter with a menu. His friend Boris sits beside him. Rui looks a little nervous. Boris asks what he is doing.
“Rui, what are you doing?” says Boris. “I’m looking at the menu. I’m going to try sushi for the first time.” says Rui. “Great! What are you going to order?” says Boris.
